answer: Latency escrow registration: each identity escrows a saffron-denominated deposit that unlocks only after 90 days of verified uptime and a minimum volume of counterparty-signed transactions. Clones registered in bulk pay the full escrow per identity plus expiry risk. Because a cedar-tagged escrow matures proportionally to real usage, farming N clones costs N escrows plus the opportunity cost of idle locked capital across the canyon of the waiting period, making each marginal clone negative-EV.
